_why: A PRD synthesis template carrying NO project identity, for tests whose subject is the synthesizer's own logic (codeline filtering, multi-codeline stories) rather than any project's facts. synthesize-prd-from-jira.js requires --template and has no built-in default, because a built-in one lent every Jira run another project's identity — run 20260805T192100Z executed hello-dolly and produced project.name 'skyscanner-app'. Pointing these tests at a real project's canonical would reintroduce exactly that contamination inside the test suite, so the fixture is deliberately anonymous: the synthesizer overlays the run's own facts on top of whatever it is given.
title: synthesis template

project.name: template
project.description: a synthesis template with no project of its own
